# Job 37 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 37 (24 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.7 — "seals up the hand" interpretation
- **LOGOS:** "He seals up the hand of every man" / **PNEUMA:** "he stops everyone from working"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "He seals up the hand of every man" — preserves the vivid metaphor rather than over-explaining.

---

## V.13 — "for chesed" rendering
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "for covenant-faithfulness" / **PNEUMA:** "to show his faithful love"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "for covenant-faithfulness" — follows project convention for *chesed*.

---

## V.22 — "gold" vs. "golden splendor"
- **EMET:** "gold comes" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "golden splendor"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "golden splendor" — *zahav* describes golden light from clearing storm clouds; "splendor" captures the visual.

---
*— SOPHIA*
